properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.logging-level
properties.description: Inbound Servlet HTTP logging detail: NONE, BASIC, HEADERS, or FULL. Logging is emitted at INFO when enabled.

properties.name: jfoundry.web.mvc.logging-excluded-paths
properties.description: Ant-style application paths excluded from inbound Servlet HTTP logs. The configured list replaces the default.
